mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a tightening labor market, increasing consumer spending and corporate profits, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous payroll employment growth above 0.5% and unemployment rate decline exceeding 0.1% per month signal a robust labor market, accelerating consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth rate > 0.5% and UNRATE decline > 0.1%
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth rate > 0.5% and UNRATE decline > 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: During early expansion, housing starts above 1300 thousand units signal strong consumer demand for housing, boosting construction and related sectors, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1300 during early expansion.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 105 index level signals robust manufacturing activity, supporting economic growth and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 105.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts above 1300 and retail sales growth exceeding 0.3% per month signal strong consumer spending, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1300 and RSAFS growth rate > 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL below 250 indicates low inflation, supporting continued monetary accommodation and reducing real interest rate pressure, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL < 250.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, payroll employment growth exceeding 0.8% per month signals labor market overheating, triggering monetary tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth rate > 0.8% during late-cycle expansion.
